description: The sequence of y-values that occur when drawing a sequence of squares in the plane with integer side lengths such that the bottom-left corner of the k-th square is at the nonnegative integer point (k, a(k)) and the square has side length s_k, subject to the conditions that (1) the interior of each square has a distinct pattern made by the perimeters of the other squares, and (2) the sequence (s_0, a(0), s_1, a(1), s_2, a(2), ...) is the lexicographically earliest such infinite sequence.
